pages.title: Raw Pitchblende
pages.text: Uraninite: heavy, black and pitch-glossy. Marie and Pierre Curie found two new elements in it by following its radioactivity.

$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Oklo Uraninite Ore$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Fission Husk.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Fallout Shelter chests.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Magnetite, Radium Salt.
